resources.string: Log who paid and who owes. No account, no sign-up — open the app and add an expense.
Your data stays on this phone
Dibs has no server and collects nothing. That also means backups are up to you — you can create one any time from Settings.
Your name appears next to expenses you add. You can change it later.
Theme, currency, backups, and app lock arrive as the app grows. Nothing to configure yet.
Dibs collects nothing. Your data lives on this phone and never leaves it unless you share it.
